command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj RV-P3-ld-sd-base-offset.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each (LF, trailing newline): `ld a0, 8(a1)` / `sd a2, 8(a1)` / `ld a0, -2048(a1)` / `sd a2, 2047(a1)`. The offset is a byte displacement because RV64 does not scale the load/store immediate; `-2048` and `2047` are the signed imm12 endpoints. The address is two operands in the plan (`base` + `disp`), not one memory payload (ADR-0008).
